pages.title: Wonderlab | SPARK Museum of Electrical Invention
pages.excerpt: Wonderlab is a new, fully interactive science gallery at SPARK Museum, designed to ignite curiosity, inspire discovery, and bring hands-on STEM learning to more children and families across Whatcom Co
headings: Wonderlab will be a third place for our community supporting intergenerational learning and discovery.
Field trip integration will allow us to have a lasting impact on STEM Education in our School system by providing high quality hands on experiences to support classroom learning.
Professionally designed exhibits will enable a self-guided experience in the gallery, while allowing SPARK staff and volunteers to focus on innovative programming that complements the exhibits.
Large Anchor exhibits on key science topics will be supported by Discovery stations offering endless opportunities for exploration and imagination to thrive.
Make a one-time gift or set up a monthly donation here.
Together, we can build a space where curiosity thrives, creativity grows, and every visitor discover the joy of learning.
